issues.body:
背景：#1510 评测闭环的「基线对比层」。目的：同模型、同提示词，只换 harness（pacman / Claude Code CLI / 裸 pi 循环），比谁做出的页面更好。「训练」只指优化 harness，不微调模型。

## 设计要点
- 只变 harness，其余锁死：模型、提示词、时间与 token 上限一致。对照组三个：pacman、Claude Code CLI、裸 pi 循环（用来区分提升来自 harness 还是多花了 token）。
- 强弱两档模型都测。弱档候选 glm-5.3-flash / deepseek-v4.1-flash，强档候选 glm-5.3（均 1M 上下文；不用 MiniMax M3）。待 ian 确认。
- 8 到 10 道页面题，类型拉开（落地页、仪表盘、表单、交互小工具等）；每题每个 harness 跑 3 到 5 次。
- 打分三层：
  1. 机器判：能否构建、控制台无报错、Playwright 截图、需求清单逐条断言。
  2. 盲评：截图打乱顺序，强模型按固定细则成对比较，正反顺序各评一次。
  3. 人抽查：ian 每批盲看若干组，校准模型评分。
- 同时记录耗时、token、重试次数，报告「单位成本质量」。
- 题库与打分细则放 `integration/eval/**`，属 ADR 0022 保护路径，agent 不能改自己的尺子。

## 分步
- 现在做：写题库 + 打分细则（纯文档与脚本骨架）；用裸 pi 循环在弱档跑一轮，验证题目难度与打分是否靠谱。
- 等 #1511–#1514 合并、自举闭环跑通后：跑 pacman 与 Claude Code CLI 的正式对比，并和「开发完善前」的基线再比一次。

## 待确认
- 模型选择（见上）。
- Claude Code CLI 能否接公司中转的模型；接不上则对照组换其他开源 CLI harness。

依赖：#1510（spec 29 / ADR 0022）、#1514。

## 结果

| 模型 | 结果 | 备注 |
|---|---|---|
| glm-5.3-flash | 通。stop_reason end_turn，回复 PONG | 同一提示词两次墙钟 3 秒、39 秒，波动大 |
| glm-5.3 | 通。stop_reason end_turn | 墙钟 58 秒；另一次 API 耗时 102 秒；回复正文里夹了推理文字，截取的前 400 字符没看到干净的 PONG |

两个模型的单次请求都带约 10.6K 输入 token（Claude Code 自带的系统提示），输出 16 token。

## 能通的环境变量

```
ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=http://112.80.47.186:8783
ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN=<中转的 key>
ANTHROPIC_MODEL=<模型名>
ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL=<同一个模型名>
ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL=<同一个模型名>
CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC=1
CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=<独立的临时目录，避开 ~/.claude 里的 hook 和设置>
```

命令：`claude -p "<提示词>" --model <模型名> --max-turns 1`，不设 `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`。base URL 末尾不带 `/v1`，中转自己接 `/v1/messages`。

## 注意

- Claude Code 不认识这两个模型名，启动时会提示并按 200K 上下文处理（pi 侧是 1M）。文档里有「gateway 或自定义模型 ID 校正窗口」的章节，评测大上下文任务前要先设；模型名带 `[1M]` 后缀是否生效我没试，只是推断。
- 返回的 `total_cost_usd` 约 0.043 是按未知模型估的，不可信，评测别用它算成本。
- 小模型槽位（SMALL_FAST 和 HAIKU）我两个都设成了同一个模型，没有单独验证不设会怎样；推断是不设会去调默认的 haiku 模型名，中转未必有。
开工前置项（ian 2026-10-22 提出）：Claude Code 接 glm-5.3-flash 时，模型名后加 `[1m]` 后缀（即 `glm-5.3-flash[1m]`），验证启动时是否还提示按 200K 处理、实际能否跑超过 200K 的上下文。通了就把带后缀的写法作为评测时 Claude Code 一侧的标准设置，保证和 pi、pacman 同为 1M 窗口。

| `glm-5.3-flash[1m]` | 通，stop_reason end_turn，回复 PONG | 1000000（最大输出 32000） |

- 同类错在已有防护之后又出现：复发加一，自动开升级票，建议更高一级的防护。
- 连续若干周拦截为 0 且无复发的防护标「待评估」，交给 #1407 的园丁每周巡检，不自动删。
- 每周一份汇总：新增几类、拦下几次、复发几次、哪些防护待评估。数据同时写入评测闭环的周汇总（#1515）。

## 失败方式

- 计数被刷：同一 PR 同一次闸红只计一次。
- 复发判断误报：按类别键匹配，匹配规则写进台账脚本并有测试。

## 验收

- [ ] 构造一次闸红，拦截数加一；同一 PR 重复运行不重复计
- [ ] 构造一次复发，自动开升级票
- [ ] 汇总脚本在空数据与正常数据下都能跑

## Plan

Observed: #1534 requires L2 first; `.claude/workflow.md` identifies L2 as #1535. This checkout has ledger validation and gardener reporting, but no identified L2 event producer. Confirm that integration contract before implementation.

### Files and functions
- `scripts/lessons-ledger-gate.mjs`: extend `parseEntry`, `checkEntry`, `checkLedgerRoot`, and `renderTable` for stable category identifiers and script-maintained counters; add exported event-reduction and weekly-summary functions.
- `scripts/lessons-ledger-gate.test.mjs`: add event replay, category matching, escalation, and counter-integrity coverage.
- `scripts/prepush.mjs`: extend `runPlan` to capture structured safeguard failures without changing their exit status; update `prepushPlan` if additional checks are needed.
- `scripts/prepush.test.mjs`: cover failure recording and preserved failure behavior.
- `scripts/gardener-weekly.mjs`: extend the CLI report assembly with lesson totals and safeguards awaiting evaluation.
- `scripts/gardener-weekly.test.mjs`: test empty data, normal activity, inactivity thresholds, and weekly boundaries.
- `.github/workflows/gardener-weekly.yml`: load durable event history and publish the combined report; isolate any issue-creation permission from untrusted PR execution.
- `docs/lessons/README.md`: document category keys, automated counters, event identity, inactivity policy, and migration.
- `docs/spec/29-evaluation-and-data-loop.md`: reconcile the integration contract; observed: this document says #1515’s weekly summary was replaced by Langfuse dashboards.

### Failing test first
In `scripts/lessons-ledger-gate.test.mjs`, replay one structured gate failure twice for the same repository, PR, category, gate, and failure episode: assert `Intercepts` increases exactly once. A distinct episode must increase it again.

### Numbered steps
1. Define failure modes before implementation: duplicate delivery, concurrent writes, ambiguous categories, missing history, pre-safeguard events, failed issue creation, and incomplete weekly inputs.
2. Establish L2’s structured event contract. Use explicit category keys and safeguard activation timestamps; reject unknown or ambiguous matches instead of matching symptom prose.
3. Define durable event storage and stable episode identifiers shared by local and CI producers. Preserve existing ledger counts as a migration baseline rather than resetting history.
4. Implement idempotent event reduction and counter projection. Validate manual counter changes against the baseline and recorded events.
5. Connect `runPlan` failures and L2 recurrence events. Count a blocked attempt as an interception; count an escaped same-category error after safeguard activation as a recurrence.
6. Implement retryable escalation with a durable deduplication marker and recorded issue number. Suggest a stronger safeguard; flag level-1 cases for review because no higher rung exists.
7. Generate deterministic weekly totals for new categories, interceptions, and recurrences. Mark safeguards awaiting evaluation after a configurable number of complete inactive weeks; never delete them.
8. Include those results in gardener reporting and the evaluation reporting destination confirmed in step 1; document any remaining dependency explicitly.

### Prior art
- [Danger JS](https://github.com/danger/danger-js): build the domain logic locally; its PR automation model is comparable, but does not supply this ledger’s event semantics.
- [reviewdog](https://github.com/reviewdog/reviewdog): reuse the structured-diagnostic approach, without adding a dependency solely for counters.
- [Probot](https://github.com/probot/probot): defer reuse; a separate GitHub App adds operational scope beyond the existing scripts and workflow.

### Risks
- Inference: exit codes alone cannot identify lesson categories; safeguards need explicit mappings or structured diagnostics.
- Concurrent runs and interrupted issue creation can duplicate counts or tickets unless persistence and retries are idempotent.
- Missing telemetry must mean “unknown,” not zero activity; inactivity thresholds remain a policy choice.
- Issue creation requires trusted credentials and must not execute PR-controlled code with write permissions.

### How to verify
- Run the four affected Node test files; exercise the CLI in temporary repositories with empty, normal, duplicate, concurrent, and malformed inputs.
- Use a fake GitHub command to prove one escalation request across retries; separately validate a real issue response in an authorized sandbox.
- Inspect generated ledger counters and weekly artifacts, including exact week boundaries and evaluation-report integration.
- Run `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm spec:parse`, and `pnpm prepush`; do not run `pnpm build`.

issues.title: 错误台账：按「codebase→静态检查→规则→技能→人审」五级阶梯定级与升级（poteto 纠错阶梯）
issues.body:
## 背景

ian 认定 pacman 的自进化理念来自 poteto（Lauren Tan）置顶视频里那张幻灯片：https://x.com/poteto/status/2102050467505430555 （约 15:35 和 36:12 处）。标题是「每当你纠正 agent 时」，五级按强到弱排序（幻灯片原文）：

1. codebase
2. static analysis（lint / 编译器 / CI）
3. rules / bugbot
4. skills
5. "style guide"

要点（字幕转述）：同一个错要往最强的一级堵。第 1 级是把代码结构改到这个错写不出来；第 2 级是 lint/CI 硬约束；第 3、4 级只是引导，agent 可能不照做；第 5 级只有人审能执行。她没有用「自进化」一词，「一层层叠加」是我们的解读。不走 Hermes 那种把纠正写进记忆的路线，记忆是最后手段。

## 现状对照

| 级 | pacman 现状 | 缺口 |
|---|---|---|
| 1 codebase | 无系统化机制 | 纠错时没有「改结构让错误不可能」的固定动作和检查 |
| 2 静态检查 | 已有 lint、typecheck、spec:parse、ui-debt-gate、ui-dead-class-gate | 推送前无统一入口，#1533 `pnpm prepush` 待做 |
| 3 规则/自动审核 | AGENTS.md 规则已有 | 合并就绪闸 #1404 待做 |
| 4 skills | 技能库已有 | correct skill #1407 待做 |
| 5 人审 | 有 | 人审反馈结构化落库 #1513 待做 |

## 要做

不重复已有票，只补「阶梯」这条主线：

1. 在 `docs/lessons.md` 台账里给每条错误记「落在第几级」，并把上面五级写成统一标尺，AGENTS.md 台账规则引用它（与 #1533 合并做，避免改两次 AGENTS.md）。
2. #1535（从轨迹检测出错又修好）产出候选防护时，必须标出可行的最高级，并说明为什么不能再高一级。
3. #1534（复发自动升级）把「升级」定义为沿这五级往强的方向挪，不是多写一条记忆。
4. 补第 1 级的缺口：纠错票模板加一问「能否改结构让它不可能？」，答否要写理由。

## 验收

- [ ] 台账每行有级别字段，lint 或脚本检查缺失即红
- [ ] #1535 / #1534 的票面验收引用本阶梯
- [ ] 纠错票模板含第 1 级一问

关联 #1533 #1534 #1535 #1536 #1407 #1404 #1513 #1405。动 AGENTS.md 属 ADR 0021 D4 保护路径，合并留人。

## 要做
- `pnpm traj:push`：读 `traj:export` 产出的 trajectoryPack JSONL，转成 OTLP 推到配置的地址（环境变量，如 `CAIRN_OTEL_ENDPOINT` 与鉴权头）。
- 映射：一次 build = 一个 trace，根 span `invoke_agent`；每个 step 一个子 span；模型回合用 `chat`，工具调用用 `execute_tool`；字段按 OTel GenAI 约定（`gen_ai.operation.name`、`gen_ai.provider.name`、`gen_ai.request.model`、token 用量、finish reasons 取 #1512 的 stopReason），约定外的放 `cairn.*`（`cairn.build_id`、`cairn.base_sha`、`cairn.harness_hash`、`cairn.persona` 等）。
- trace id 与 span id 由 buildId / stepId 确定性派生，同一包重推不产生重复。
- 推送前复用 #1514 的密文打码；只用 OTLP 公开协议，不引入 Langfuse SDK。

## 验收
- 对一个已合并 build 推送，Langfuse 里 trace 树结构、token、模型名正确；重推一次条数不变。
- GenAI 约定字段集中在一个映射模块，约定改名时只改一处，有单测覆盖。

## Plan

Feature: `traj:push` converts exported trajectory packs to OTLP GenAI traces and pushes to Langfuse. Already merged; remaining acceptance is a live Langfuse check on omarchy (see issue comments).

Files to change (all exist):
- `apps/server/src/trajectory-otlp.ts` — `packToOtlp()`: build → one trace, root span `invoke_agent`; per-step span with `chat` / `execute_tool` children; deterministic ids via `spanIdOf()` (sha256 of buildId+stepId path). `traceId = otlpTraceIdOfBuild(buildId)` so re-push produces identical ids.
- `packages/shared/src/genai-conventions.ts` — single mapping module: `GENAI_OPERATION`, `chatAttributes()`, `executeToolAttributes()`, `invokeAgentAttributes()` (gen_ai.* fields, `cairn.build_id`/`base_sha`/`harness_hash`/`persona` etc.).
- `packages/shared/src/otel.ts` — `parseOtlpTarget()` (reads `CAIRN_OTEL_ENDPOINT` + auth header), `otlpAttributes()`, `otlpNanos()`, `otlpTraceIdOfBuild()`.
- `apps/server/src/trajectory-push.ts` — `parsePacks()`, `resolveTarget()`, `pushPacks()`: POSTs JSON OTLP; redacts via `redactSecrets()` (#1514); local ledger `trajectory-pushes.jsonl` keyed by (endpoint, traceId) skips repeats unless `--force`.
- `apps/server/src/trajectory-push-cli.ts` — CLI, wires `pnpm traj:push` (package.json line 20).
- `apps/server/src/trajectory-transcript.ts` — `tokenCounts()`, `costUsd()`, `toolCallsOf()`, `toolOutcomesOf()`, stopReason (#1512).

Failing test to write first: extend `apps/server/test/trajectory-push.test.ts` (already 553 lines) with a case asserting the OTLP JSON shape: trace tree (root→step→chat/tool), `gen_ai.*` fields, deterministic ids across two `packToOtlp()` calls, and ledger skip + `--force` re-push.

Steps:
1. Add the failing mapping test (structure + gen_ai fields + id determinism) to `trajectory-push.test.ts`.
2. Implement `genai-conventions.ts` attribute builders; keep all naming there.
3. Implement `packToOtlp()` in `trajectory-otlp.ts` (root/step/chat/tool spans, status ERROR for failed turns, token/cost attributes).
4. Implement `parseOtlpTarget`, `pushPacks` with redaction and ledger, then the CLI.
5. `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm exec vitest run --changed`; no `pnpm build`.
6. Real acceptance on omarchy: `pnpm traj:export` one build → `pnpm traj:push` → push again without `--force`; screenshot trace tree + equal counts under `docs/verify/1570/`, close with `closes #1570`.

Risks:
- Langfuse events_only mode stores duplicate rows on re-push despite identical ids → ledger skip (option 1, decided 2026-10-25) mitigates.
- GenAI convention drift → isolated in one module with unit tests (issue acceptance).
- Endpoint/HTTP failures mid-push → `TrajectoryPushError` with pushed-count, no partial ledger entries.

Verify: green lint/typecheck/tests; live trace tree at `127.0.0.1:3000` showing model name, tokens, finish reasons; re-push adds zero rows.

### Prior art
- [langfuse/langfuse](https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse): target platform; use — self-hosted OTLP ingest (`/api/public/otel/v1/traces`) is the wire protocol, but SDK is rejected by issue (public OTLP only).
- [open-telemetry/semantic-conventions](https://github.com/open-telemetry/semantic-conventions): reuse as field-name source of truth (gen_ai.*), not vendored.
- [open-telemetry/opentelemetry-js](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-js): build — official exporter is SDK-heavy; hand-rolled JSON POST (≈50 lines) suffices and keeps the pack the single source of truth.

issues.title: 记忆-1 save_memory 写前查同类，冲突走更新（借 Mem0 的 ADD/UPDATE/DELETE/NOOP 判定）
issues.body:
## 问题

agent 记忆（`agent_memory` 表，`apps/server/src/services/chief-tools.ts` 的 `saveMemoryEntry`）只有存、删、列三个动作，没有改。存的时候不看已有条目，两条互相矛盾的记忆（例如「本仓用 npm」和后来的「本仓改用 pnpm」）会一起被 `composeWorkerSystemPrompt`（`apps/daemon/src/runner.ts`）原样注入系统提示，模型自己猜信哪条。

## 方案（不造轮子：照搬 Mem0 的判定步，不引入 Mem0 服务）

Mem0 的核心做法是：写入一条新事实前，先取出相近的已有条目，让模型在 ADD / UPDATE / DELETE / NOOP 里选一个。Cairn 每个 agent 最多 100 条、全量注入，不需要向量库，判定这一步交给写入方 agent 自己做即可，不多一次模型调用：

1. `save_memory` 落库前按标题和正文做简单相似度（同项目内、字面重叠）找候选；有候选时不落库，返回候选列表和提示「请选更新哪条，或确认新增」。
2. 新增 `update_memory(memoryId, content)`，记旧值（为记忆-2 的取代关系铺路）。
3. 显式 `force: true` 才允许在有候选时仍新增。

## 失败方式（先列再写）

- 相似但不冲突的两条被误判为候选：只返回提示，不拦死，`force` 可过。
- agent 忽略候选反复重试：第二次同内容返回 409。
- 跨项目条目被当作候选：候选只取本项目与全局（与 #1494 同口径）。
- 来自 issue 围栏的文本：沿用 #1406 的拦截。

## 参考

- Mem0 论文：https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.19413
- 差距报告：长期记忆与 RSI 差距（线程产出）

issues.title: 记忆-2 记忆加失效时间与取代关系（借 Graphiti 的双时间做法），被取代的条目不再注入
issues.body:
## 问题

`agent_memory` 只有 `createdAt` / `updatedAt`。记忆过期或被推翻时只能删掉，删了就查不到「以前为什么这么认为」，也没法统计哪条记忆常被推翻。

## 方案（不造轮子：照搬 Zep / Graphiti 的时间字段，不引入图数据库）

Graphiti 遇到矛盾时不删旧事实，而是给旧边记上失效时间，查询默认只看当前有效的。Cairn 在现有 sqlite 表上加三列即可：

- `invalidAt`：失效时刻，空 = 当前有效。
- `supersededBy`：被哪条记忆取代。
- `lastInjectedAt`：最近一次被注入的时刻，给后续清理与配额腾挪用。

读路径（claim 载荷的 `agent.memories`、chief 的 `memories` 工具）默认只取 `invalidAt` 为空的条目；配额 100 只算有效条目。记忆-1 的 `update_memory` 改为「旧条目置失效 + 新条目指回旧条目」。

## 失败方式

- 迁移把旧数据全标成失效：迁移只加可空列，默认空。
- 取代链成环：写入时校验目标仍有效。
- 失效条目仍占配额导致写不进：配额只数有效条目。
- UI `记忆 · n/100` 与服务端口径不一致：共用同一常量与同一查询。

## 依赖

记忆-1（#1574）。

## 参考

- Graphiti：https://neo4j.com/blog/developer/graphiti-knowledge-graph-memory/

issues.title: 记忆-3 记忆回归评测：冲突、跨项目泄漏、过期三类用例
issues.body:
## 问题

记忆的行为目前没有任何评测。#1494 修了跨项目注入，但只有单测，没有「模型拿到记忆后做对了没有」的判分。改记忆（#1574、本票之后的改动）没有尺子量好坏。

## 方案（复用 `integration/eval/chief-dispatch` 的框架，不新写 runner）

照 chief-dispatch 的做法：给隔离库种好记忆和任务，跑一个回合，读环境终态判分，不读 transcript。三类用例，每类 6–8 条：

1. **冲突**：库里有新旧两条矛盾记忆（旧条带失效时间或较早），任务需要用到这条事实。判：产出遵循新的那条。
2. **跨项目泄漏**：A 项目的记忆不该影响 B 项目的任务。判：B 的产出不含 A 的专有约定。
3. **过期**：记忆说的东西在仓库里已经变了（例如脚本名改了）。判：agent 以仓库实况为准，并调用 `update_memory` 或 `delete_memory`。

指标：`decision_ok`（二值，主指标）、`memory_write_ok`（第 3 类是否修正了记忆）。

## 失败方式

- 评测贴天花板（chief-dispatch 的教训）：难例不靠把规则写进提示词来「可判」。
- 链路失败被计分：沿用 chief-dispatch 的零 token 与 `step != done` 拦截。

## 依赖

第 3 类的 `memory_write_ok` 依赖 #1574 的 `update_memory`；第 1、2 类可以先做，作为改动前的基线。

issues.title: 记忆-4 跨任务经验沉淀：从轨迹包按 ACE「反思→整理」产出候选记忆与技能条目
issues.body:
## 问题

现在跨任务的经验只在 agent 自己想起来调 `save_memory` 时才留下（工具描述还写着「只在任务要求或确实值得时」）。一次构建里踩过的坑、摸清的命令，下一张票基本从零开始。开发侧的 `docs/lessons.md` 靠人和 Claude 手工记，19 行里 10 行停在最软的「记忆」级。

## 方案（不造轮子：照 ACE 的三角色，抽取部分与 #1535 共用）

ACE（Agentic Context Engineering）把上下文当成一本会长的手册：生成者干活，反思者读轨迹找出可复用的经验，整理者把经验写成逐条条目、确定性合并、定期去重。Cairn 已经有轨迹包（#1511），缺的是后两步：

1. 构建收尾后，对轨迹包跑一次反思（低成本模型，派给 pi），输出候选条目：`{kind: memory|skill|guard, project, title, content, evidence: [轨迹里的步号]}`。
2. `guard` 类交给 #1535（转成防护候选）；`memory` 类走 #1574 的冲突判定后落库为「待确认」；`skill` 类生成对技能文件的补丁草稿。
3. 人确认或下一次被用上并且构建成功后才转为正式条目。

## 失败方式

- 反思产出大量重复：整理步按标题与正文去重，复用 #1574 的相似度。
- 把一次性的偶然现象写成规律：要求至少两条不同构建的证据才转正。
- 把 issue 原文抄进记忆（注入面）：沿用 #1406 的围栏拦截。
- 成本失控：只对失败后转绿、或被人打回过的构建做反思。

## 参考

- ACE：https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.04618
- Lilian Weng, Harness Engineering for Self-Improvement：https://lilianweng.github.io/posts/2026-07-04-harness/

issues.title: RSI-1 改 harness 的 PR 必须附回归评测结果，否则不能自动合并
issues.body:
## 问题

自举闭环（spec 28 / ADR 0021）走到 `autonomous` 以后，Cairn 可以自己改自己的 harness 并合并。合并就绪闸的可自动合并集（`packages/shared/src/records/merge-gate.ts` 的 `AUTO_MERGE_PATH_GLOBS`）包含 `apps/*/src/**` 和 `packages/*/src/**`，而 harness 的核心就在这里：

- 总管系统提示词：`apps/server/src/services/chief.ts`（`composeChiefSystemPrompt`）
- 工具描述：`packages/shared/src/protocol/chief-tools.ts`
- worker 提示词组装：`apps/daemon/src/runner.ts`（`composeWorkerSystemPrompt`）

也就是说，一张只改提示词的 PR 只要 CI 绿、闸判定 go 就能自动合并，而 CI 不跑 chief-dispatch 评测（一次约 $5、35 分钟）。chief-dispatch 的 `harness_paths` 已经列出了这些文件，但它只拦评测自己的重跑，不拦合并。

Lilian Weng 总结的七个瓶颈里，「奖励作弊」一条的建议是评测器和权限放在环外。Cairn 的评测器本身已在环外（`integration/eval/**` 和 `.claude/**` 不在可自动合并集，默认拒绝），缺的是「改 harness 必须过评测」这一环。

## 方案

1. 把 chief-dispatch 的 `harness_paths` 提到 shared 常量，合并就绪闸和评测 runner 共用一份。
2. PR 的改动命中 harness 路径时，就绪闸多一个条件：`docs/verify/<票号>/` 里有一份对当前 `patchDigest` 的回归评测结果（`decision_ok` 不低于基线的置信区间下限）；缺失或不达标转 `user`。
3. 评测结果文件由 runner 生成并带 `harness_sha`，闸只校验格式、摘要与阈值，不自己跑评测。

## 需要 ian 拍板

这条改的是合并就绪闸的判定（ADR 0021 D4 ④ 闸源码，保护路径），按项目规则先问 ian 再施工。

## 失败方式

- 评测结果是旧补丁上跑的：绑定 `patchDigest`，不对就拒。
- 只改了工具描述里的一个字也要跑 $5：允许低成本档（小样本 + 模型降档）先跑，结果差才要求全量。
- 伪造结果文件：结果带 runner 写入的 trace 摘要，证据维度复核。
comments:
2026-10-23 ian 在项目线程里批准了本票方案（改合并就绪闸，ADR 0021 D4 ④ 保护路径）。可以开工；施工 PR 改的是闸源码，按 D4 仍由 ian 合并。

issues.title: RSI-2 用现成 GEPA 跑一轮提示词自动优化，变体与分数（含失败）全部存档
issues.body:
## 问题

现在的 harness 优化是人（Claude 线程）读失败轨迹、改提示词、重跑评测：chief-dispatch 的名字与 id 错位就是这样从 80% 修到 100%（`.claude/hillclimb/chief-dispatch/metrics.md`）。这条路有效，但每一轮都要人；优化器本身没有被自动化，也没有把试过又失败的变体留下来。

## 方案（不造轮子：用 GEPA，不自己写搜索器）

GEPA（Genetic-Pareto，DSPy 团队开源，`pip install gepa`）读失败轨迹、用自然语言反思改写提示词，在多目标上保留帕累托前沿。它支持自定义适配器，Cairn 只需要写一个适配器把候选提示词交给现有的 TS runner：

1. 适配器：候选文本 → 写进评测种子的提示词覆盖 → 调 `integration/eval/chief-dispatch/run-eval.mts`（小样本档）→ 回传分数与失败轨迹摘要。
2. 优化对象先只开一个：总管的派工规则段落。chief-dispatch 已饱和，目标集用 E2 的 pacman-bench（#1517–#1519），chief-dispatch 作回归门。
3. 存档：每个变体的文本、分数、成本、失败原因落 `.claude/hillclimb/<flow>/variants/`，失败的也留（DGM 的存档思路，也对应 Weng 说的「负结果难留」）。
4. 产出只是候选 PR，走 RSI-1 的评测门和人审，不直接改产品代码。

## 失败方式

- 过拟合优化集：optimize / holdout 拆分（#1517 已规划），只看 holdout 涨幅。
- 改出很长的提示词把成本推高：成本作为第二目标进帕累托。
- 评测器被优化器利用：评测代码与用例在 D4 保护路径下，适配器只能写提示词覆盖。

## 参考

- GEPA：https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.19457
- Darwin Gödel Machine：https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.22954

mergedPulls.title: daemon(1744): recover message-shaped compaction summaries
mergedPulls.body:
## What

This is the message-shaped provider recovery stage for #1744. `compactionCeilingFetch` retries pi summary requests that exceed a provider context window. It lowers the output limit when enough room remains, or shortens conversation input within four attempts. Summary system and developer messages activate recovery. Ordinary requests pass through unchanged.

Enabled thinking retains its original budget. Every output rewrite reserves at least one token above that budget. A 4096-token thinking budget therefore keeps an output limit of at least 4097 instead of producing an invalid 512-token retry. The lessons use main's per-file ledger.

This delivery supersedes #1868. #1935 overlaps the earlier implementation and retains the boundary problems corrected here.

## Verified

The same wrapper-level controls failed before the thinking-budget fix and pass afterward:

```text
pnpm exec vitest run apps/daemon/test/pi-compaction-thinking-budget.test.ts
Before: Tests 2 failed | 1 passed (3)

pnpm exec vitest run apps/daemon/test/pi-compaction-ceiling.test.ts apps/daemon/test/pi-compaction-thinking-budget.test.ts
After: Tests 22 passed (22)
```

Actual output: [failing controls](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/cairn/66cde23b/docs/verify/1744/thinking-budget/red.log), [passing controls](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/cairn/66cde23b/docs/verify/1744/thinking-budget/green.log), and [serialized retry parameters](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/cairn/66cde23b/docs/verify/1744/thinking-budget/wire.json). The recorded generic-error replay keeps thinking enabled at 4096, lowers output from 8192 to 4097, and shortens input until the deterministic provider accepts it.

`pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, and `pnpm spec:parse` pass. Logs: [lint](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/cairn/66cde23b/docs/verify/1744/thinking-budget/lint.log), [types](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/cairn/66cde23b/docs/verify/1744/thinking-budget/typecheck.log), and [spec collection](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/cairn/66cde23b/docs/verify/1744/thinking-budget/spec-parse.log).

Earlier boundary controls remain recorded in [recovery review](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/cairn/e59ccc27/docs/verify/1744/recovery-review.md), [original failures](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/cairn/e59ccc27/docs/verify/1744/recovery-red.log), and [JSON failures](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/cairn/e59ccc27/docs/verify/1744/structure-red.log).

## Upstream

pi 1.4.0 estimates summary input and clamps output, but the provider can count more input tokens or reject the input itself. The wrapper handles actual HTTP 400/413 ceiling errors. The installed Anthropic SDK 0.129.0 requires enabled `budget_tokens` to be at least 1024 and strictly below `max_tokens`; output rewrites enforce that constraint. The upstream compaction reserve remains 16384.

## Risk

Two-way door. The affected behavior is summary HTTP retry and daemon compaction logging. Quoted-marker, malformed JSON, ordinary request, and non-ceiling error controls check the pass-through boundaries. Attempts are bounded at four and exhausted recovery returns the provider error.

These are deterministic request-level and upstream summary tests. A fresh real-provider deployment and complete production step survival remain unverified. Responses-shaped requests using `input` and `max_output_tokens` remain unchanged. Those remaining parts of #1744 are not accepted by this PR.

Historical commits contain parent-closing keywords. The audited [squash message](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/cairn/66cde23b/docs/verify/1744/thinking-budget/squash-message.txt) must be used explicitly. The [message guard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/cairn/66cde23b/docs/verify/1744/thinking-budget/check-merge-message.mjs) rejects the three historical closing keywords and accepts the audited message. Default aggregation of historical commit messages is unsuitable here.

## Acceptance

- [x] Message-shaped summary ceiling errors retry with bounded output fitting or input reduction, including oversized final blocks: 22 passing cases linked above.
- [x] Enabled thinking retains its budget and every rewritten output limit exceeds it: both reported-input and generic-error controls, plus serialized retry evidence.
- [x] Exhausted recovery logs the ceiling reason and returns the provider error: terminal-failure control in the original suite.
- [x] Ordinary requests and non-ceiling errors retain their behavior: quoted-marker, JSON boundary, and invalid-key controls.
- [x] This partial delivery leaves the parent issue open: audited squash message and its negative/positive controls linked above.

## Issues

Part of #1744. Production step survival and Responses-shaped recovery remain outstanding. The final squash message must use the audited text and leave #1744 open.

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"xiechimon"} -->
_Requested by **ian**_

## What

Research for #1607: can ACP (Agent Client Protocol) serve as one execution surface for outside agent CLIs, instead of one hand-written bridge per agent? The result is `docs/research/1607-acp-execution-surface.md`.

Conclusions in the doc:

- Build an ACP backend, but keep the existing `pi.ts` and `claude-code.ts` bridges. ACP fits a third family: agent CLIs installed on the machine that hold their own login.
- Start with Gemini CLI. Its binary ships `--acp` (registry `@google/gemini-cli@0.65.0`, released 2026-10-20), and the TypeScript SDK docs use it as the reference agent.
- Codex and Claude Code reach ACP through adapters, not their own ACP server. The Claude SDK bridge already carries usage, skill denial and strict MCP that an adapter would drop.
- Copilot CLI (`--acp`, still public preview on its agents page) and Hermes (`hermes acp`, `v0.22.5`, not in the auth registry) wait until the Gemini probe is green.
- A trajectory pack (#1511) cannot be rebuilt from ACP events alone: four-way token counts, cache writes, the five cost parts, plan versions, gate verdicts and merge results are not in the stable protocol.

The doc compares each capability the two current bridges provide (streaming, tool call records, stopReason and usage, resume, cancel, command-gate, MCP injection, skills injection) with ACP coverage, sketches `apps/daemon/src/backend/acp.ts`, covers spec 17, ADR 0018 and ADR 0020, and ends with two build ticket drafts. It opens no PR, needs no secret and has read-only permissions. `ci.yml` is unchanged: the map reads live issue state, so a PR check on it would turn red for reasons the PR did not cause. The map is regenerated in this PR: 609 rows (it was 348). Ticket: #1527.

## Verified

`--check` on the committed file (`docs/verify/1527/check-clean.txt`):

```

exit=0
```

mergedPulls.title: server(1403): CI grind reads checks by head SHA, only required checks decide, BEHIND and DIRTY handled
mergedPulls.body:
## What

Segment 3 of #1403, the last segment of bootstrap phase P2 (`docs/spec/28` §4 P2). It makes the CI grind read GitHub the way GitHub itself decides mergeability. The plan, GitHub facts and failure modes are in [seg3-plan.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/pacman/52f5ffaeff20f24d9ac8cc583a7a57bf4e791f9a/docs/verify/1403/seg3-plan.md).

All in `apps/server/src/services/ci-loop.ts` unless noted.

**Checks by head SHA.** For the build's own open PR targeting the default branch (`isOwnOpenDefaultPull`, `lib/github.ts`), the grind reads `pulls/{n}` and then the check runs of that head SHA. Any other PR is read by branch name, without conflict handling.

**Push lag.** Within 5 minutes after pacman pushed, a PR whose head is not that push is not judged. Steps that pushed nothing do not count as a push. Past the grace, the PR head decides.

**Only required checks decide green.** The required list (`githubRequiredChecks`, `lib/github.ts`) combines classic branch protection (ignored when `enforcement_level` is `off`) and ruleset checks, and keeps `/` in branch names. It is cached 10 minutes, and a failed read is not retried by other cards in the same sweep. Runs that share a name pass on one success.

**Blocked instead of green or fixed**, each with one hint per round:
- cancelled, neutral or skipped on a required check;
- `action_required`, which is not sent to a `[ci-fix]` round;
- a required check still missing after the grace.

**BEHIND** gets a hint naming update-branch with `expected_head_sha`. No request is sent.

**DIRTY** gets a same-branch `[merge-conflict]` build step that merges the default branch in, with no rebase or force-push. The branch name is shell-quoted in the prompt. At most 2 rounds: at building the card then goes to failed, at review it gets a hint. A round stops unclaimed verify and review steps; at review the card first goes back to queued, and verify is queued again once it is back in review.

**`step.finishedAt`** (`apps/server/src/db/schema.ts`, migration `0047_step_finished_at.sql`) is written when a build step stops and orders the last pushed checkpoint (`builds.ts`).

**From the last pr-gate on #1509:** the closing-shape check on the squash title now tests the PR title alone. With " (#n)" appended, titles such as "Add CI fix" matched and lost their title.

**Docs:** spec 02's GitHub bullet; spec 28 §8 changes only the P2 row.

## Verified

Failure modes first, in the plan (§8, §10, §12 to §15, §18). GitHub's REST facts for pulls, check runs, branch protection, rules for a branch and update-branch are quoted there with their doc URLs.

Tests first ([seg3-red-green.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/pacman/52f5ffaeff20f24d9ac8cc583a7a57bf4e791f9a/docs/verify/1403/seg3-red-green.txt)), `pr-seg3.test.ts` and the touched suites. Each red leg ran before its fix and went green after:

```
plan        26 failed | 13 passed
review 1    11 failed | 40 passed
review 2     6 failed | 54 passed
review 3     5 failed | 61 passed
review 4     5 failed | 67 passed
review 5     4 failed | 72 passed
merge review 3 failed | 76 passed
title fix    3 failed | 10 passed
```

Mutations ([seg3-mutations.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/pacman/52f5ffaeff20f24d9ac8cc583a7a57bf4e791f9a/docs/verify/1403/seg3-mutations.txt)): 54 of 54 killed (23 base, then 9, 6, 7, 5, 3 and 1 for the later fixes). The first run's report misread vitest's summary; the file records that and the two test changes it led to.

Gates on `cde42fc` ([gates-seg3.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/pacman/52f5ffaeff20f24d9ac8cc583a7a57bf4e791f9a/docs/verify/1403/gates-seg3.txt), three dated runs), all exit 0:
- lint, typecheck, spec:parse;
- `vitest run --changed origin/main` (155 files, 2150 passed);
- `e2e:affected` (8 passed; only server files differ from main now, so the server family ran).

The full server suite on the merge of main `d4fd908` passes 2459 tests. `db:check` passes with the migration at main's tail.

Reviews ([seg3-reviews.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/pacman/52f5ffaeff20f24d9ac8cc583a7a57bf4e791f9a/docs/verify/1403/seg3-reviews.txt)):
- /code-review at medium six times: five rounds on the segment, one on the merges of 2b. Each finding was fixed tests first or declined with a reason in the plan.
- /simplify, one pass.
- /security-review not needed: no file on the AGENTS.md list is touched.

## Upstream

No dependency. GitHub REST: `GET pulls/{n}`, `GET commits/{ref}/check-runs`, `GET branches/{branch}` (its protection summary) and `GET rules/branches/{branch}`, as quoted in the plan.

## Risk

Two decisions to confirm:
- Required checks that end `neutral` or `skipped` count as not passing, as the ticket's scope says. GitHub's own merge box accepts them, so a required job that a path filter skips leaves the card in building, with a hint each round.
- The rules endpoint's 403 counts as "no rulesets" only when its message is GitHub's plan wording (`/upgrade to github|enable this feature/i`). The docs list only 200 for this endpoint, so that wording is assumed. If GitHub words it differently, the card stays in building rather than being judged on a partial list.

Kept:
- A development or verify database that applied this branch's earlier migration numbers (0045 or 0046) before the renumber needs a reset; only databases that ran this unmerged branch are affected.
- A PR read that keeps failing leaves the card in building.
- The anonymous grind now makes more reads, against GitHub's hourly limit for unauthenticated requests.
- Commit-status-only required contexts become a hint after the grace, not green.
- The chief step's done or failed write has no `finishedAt`; `services/machines.ts` is on the security list, so the schema comment is narrowed to build steps instead.

From the pr-gate run at `52f5ffa` (go, no blocking finding), handed to pacman's own build as follow-ups:
- Without a GitHub connection the grind now reads the PR and the required list as well as the check runs, roughly 130 anonymous requests an hour for one building card against GitHub's 60. Once the shared per-IP budget is spent, the review reconcile and the #931 / #1217 guards skip for the rest of the hour.
- A required check that reports only as a commit status, or ends neutral or skipped, keeps the card in building with a hint each round and no automatic way out (the decision above).
- A `[merge-conflict]` round that finds nothing to commit (the conflict was resolved on GitHub first, or `dirty` was stale) fails at the zero-change artifact gate, as `[ci-fix]` rounds already do.
- With no required list, neutral and skipped runs do not block; the ticket's "neutral / skipped not green" applies to required checks only.
- Two spec 02 sentences still describe the old behaviour (the reconcile bullet's "no finish-time column", and the closing-shape clause after the title rule); they are corrected in the section 8 ledger PR that follows this one.

Handed to follow-up from the #1509 pr-gate (recorded in the reviews file): closing keywords in a PR description, a pending verify step claimed during the merge request, the ADR 0021 D2 note waiting for the user, a #1217 guard test with GitHub connected, and the unauthenticated merge route.

Live legs 待宿主: a real PR's required checks, BEHIND and DIRTY on GitHub.

This PR adds a migration. The user authorised the session on 2026-10-22 to merge once pr-gate is go and CI is green.

## Acceptance

- [x] Checks are read by the PR's head SHA, with push lag; only required checks decide green (`pr-seg3.test.ts`, red/green)
- [x] BEHIND hints update-branch; DIRTY queues a same-branch merge-conflict step, at most 2 rounds (`pr-seg3.test.ts`)
- [x] `step.finishedAt` written and used to order the last pushed checkpoint; migration 0047 at main's tail, `db:check` passes
- [x] The squash title keeps titles that only end in a closing word (`pr-merge-api.test.ts` 2b-D41c)
- [x] 54 of 54 mutations killed (`seg3-mutations.txt`)
- [x] lint / typecheck / spec:parse / vitest --changed / e2e:affected pass (`gates-seg3.txt`)
- [x] pr-gate at `52f5ffa`: go, no blocking finding

## Issues

Part of #1403. This is the last P2 code segment. The squash message carries no closing line: #1403 stays open for its host acceptance leg (a manual merge on GitHub turns the card done within a minute), which is 待宿主. The pr-gate run at `52f5ffa` raised this.

```
For the build's own open PR on the default branch, the grind reads the
PR and the check runs of its head SHA, waits out the push lag, and
lets only required checks decide: classic protection and ruleset
checks, with cancelled, neutral, skipped, action_required and missing
required checks blocked with a hint. BEHIND hints update-branch;
DIRTY queues a same-branch merge-conflict step, at most two rounds.
Steps record finishedAt (migration 0047), which orders the last
pushed checkpoint. The squash title's closing-shape check tests the
```

mergedPulls.title: server(1403): pressing merge on a GitHub task merges its PR through the API
mergedPulls.body:
## What

Segment 2b of #1403, bootstrap phase P2. It builds design D, which the user chose on 2026-10-22 ([decision](https://github.com/xiechimon/pacman/issues/1403#issuecomment-6338182522)).

For a GitHub-form task whose build has a recorded PR, pressing merge in pacman now merges the PR through GitHub's REST API with `sha`. No machine merge step is queued for it. This also settles the earlier "option B" decision on #1414: the completion row is written only when the PR is actually merged.

**Routing (`apps/server/src/services/builds.ts`).** `requestMerge` sends a GitHub-form build with a recorded PR to `mergeThroughGithub`; `githubPrOf` is the single test for that. Everything else keeps today's merge step: hosted, local, and GitHub form without a PR. The wire answer stays `202 {delegated: true}`.

**Checks before the PUT, all without writes.**
1. The phase is review, or failed and restorable.
2. The build is the todo's current build, with no step in flight.
3. The #1217 guard passes, then the phase is checked again.
4. The permission gate passes.
5. There is a usable token:
   - no connection: 409 asking to connect GitHub;
   - token that does not decrypt: reconnect;
   - no secret box: server key.
6. No merge of this build is already in flight.

Then the server reads the PR and requires:
- it is the build's own PR, and its author has write access;
- its base is the default branch;
- its head equals the build's last pushed checkpoint (40 hex characters).

**The merge.** `PUT pulls/{n}/merge` (`githubMergePull` in `apps/server/src/lib/github.ts`) with:
- `sha` = that checkpoint;
- `merge_method` squash;
- `commit_title` = `<PR title> (#n)`, or pacman's own `Merge pull request #n` when that text contains a closing keyword followed by a token with a digit;
- `commit_message` is always sent: `closes #N` only when the task came from an issue of the same repository, otherwise `Merged by pacman.`, so GitHub never fills the body from the PR.

| GitHub's answer | What pacman does |
|---|---|
| Merged | Announcement, a merged row, the card goes to done. |
| Refused (4xx), including a rate-limited 429 or 403 | 409 with GitHub's cleaned message, plus the wait time when known (`retry-after` first) and the next step. Nothing is written, and a failed card stays failed. |
| No clear answer (timeout, network error, 5xx, unreadable 200) | 202 and one row. Segment 1's merged read finishes the card on the next sweep. |

**Support around the merge.**
- An in-memory set of merges in flight feeds `hasActiveStep`, so the reconcile sweep never writes during the PUT.
- `lastPushedCheckpoint` is shared with the reconcile.
- The merge step's done tail no longer finishes a GitHub-form build that has a PR. This covers merge steps queued before the upgrade.
- Rate-limit headers have one parser (`rateLimitOf`) for the intake, the webhook and the merge. A value that is empty, negative, fractional or longer than ten digits counts as absent.

**From the post-merge pr-gate run on #1489.** Adopting another PR from the build's branch now requires the author's `author_association` to be OWNER, MEMBER or COLLABORATOR, captured live. Also:
- the confirm-phase 409 is stated in spec 02;
- the foreign path's phase re-read is pinned;
- the `listFailures` cleanup is pinned;
- the skipped-relist stamp is pinned.

**Web.** The merge dialog shows the refusal text (en and zh), on the board and on the task detail page.

**Docs.**
- spec 02, A6 and §4.2, describe the new path.
- spec 28 §8 updates only the P2 row.

## Verified

Failure modes first ([seg2b-failure-modes.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/pacman/a281674660f311387ef68b782912cae4c99987c5/docs/verify/1403/seg2b-failure-modes.txt)). They quote GitHub's merge endpoint parameters, status codes and response schema, the rate-limit rules, and the `author_association` enum. Dated notes were appended for the rate-limit change. The live capture of the branch PR list with author associations is [live-branch-pulls-assoc.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/pacman/a281674660f311387ef68b782912cae4c99987c5/docs/verify/1403/live-branch-pulls-assoc.json).

**Round 3, from the pr-gate run at `efea0f2`** (go, six suggestions; dispositions in [seg2b-r3-reviews.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/pacman/ff4c424724f5f12641aad7677d5527ca02f63675/docs/verify/1403/seg2b-r3-reviews.txt)):
- The adoption rejection floor counted only PRs by authors with write access, so a newer PR closed unmerged but opened by another login was ignored and an older merged PR could be re-adopted. The floor now counts all of the build's own PRs; the author rule still decides which PR may be adopted. Round 2's test [2b-P7g] pinned the regressed behaviour and is flipped; [2b-P7h] is new.
- A failed PR read on the merge path (404, 429, rate-limited 403, 5xx, non-JSON or array 200, timeout, network error) answers 409 with one GET, no PUT and no row ([2b-D44a/c/d]). These passed at once and are pins.
- Rate limits answering 409 is the user's decision of 2026-10-22 ([comment](https://github.com/xiechimon/pacman/issues/1403#issuecomment-6344983763)); the code comment, test header and spec 02 cite it.
- Main `2ff0b93` is merged, with no conflict.

Round 3 red/green ([seg2b-r3-red-green.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/pacman/ff4c424724f5f12641aad7677d5527ca02f63675/docs/verify/1403/seg2b-r3-red-green.txt)): the floor tests failed 4 before the fix; `pr-merge-api.test.ts` and `pr-reconcile.test.ts` then pass 305 of 305. Mutations ([seg2b-r3-mutations.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/pacman/ff4c424724f5f12641aad7677d5527ca02f63675/docs/verify/1403/seg2b-r3-mutations.txt)): 8 of 8 caught. /code-review at medium found six items; four are fixed, two are in Risk. Gates on `6873877` ([gates-seg2b-r3.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/pacman/ff4c424724f5f12641aad7677d5527ca02f63675/docs/verify/1403/gates-seg2b-r3.txt)), all exit 0: lint, typecheck, spec:parse, `vitest run --changed origin/main` (2086 passed, 1 skipped), `e2e:affected` (full suite, 1182 passed).

After #1525 merged, main `f8483f7` is merged in at `8054460`; the only conflict was spec 28 §8's P2 and P3 rows. Gates on the merge ([gates-seg2b-r4.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/pacman/0d67951e35e8b64db780c3ecf9375b71f2659f16/docs/verify/1403/gates-seg2b-r4.txt)), all exit 0: lint, typecheck, spec:parse, `vitest run --changed origin/main` (2089 passed, 1 skipped), `e2e:affected` (full suite, 1182 passed).

This is the first server-side write to GitHub with the team token that merges code.

## Upstream

No dependency. GitHub REST `PUT /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{pull_number}/merge`, as ADR 0021 D2 names it. GitHub's page also recommends an async merge endpoint; design D uses the synchronous one.

## Risk

One-way-ish: this changes how a person's merge works for GitHub-form tasks with a PR.

The live REST merge has only run against a fake GitHub. The real-host leg, a merge from pacman landing on GitHub, is 待宿主.

Kept as decided:
- Squash only. A repository that disallows squash returns GitHub's 405 message.
- A merge step queued before the upgrade blocks the API merge and the reconcile until a machine claims it.
- MEMBER and COLLABORATOR may have only read access. A private org member can show as CONTRIBUTOR to an anonymous reader; adoption then falls back to segment 1's close behaviour.
- A pending verify step can be claimed while the merge request runs (up to 15 s). Closing that needs a check in the claim path in `machines.ts`, which is on the security list, so it goes to a follow-up.
- A real 403 refusal on the last unit of quota is reported as rate-limited. GitHub's message is still shown.

From round 2:
- PRs are opened by the agent with the machine's `gh` login; the team token is only the push credential. If that login is a bot or app (association NONE or CONTRIBUTOR), every merge press answers 409 and writes nothing. A review card can still finish through a merge on GitHub and the reconcile; a failed card cannot, and the person closes or reruns it. Every PR on this repository so far is OWNER-authored.
- An unclear answer (timeout, network error, 5xx, unreadable 200) moves a failed card back to review even if GitHub refused; the PR stays open at the review gate (spec 02 A6).
- Closing keywords in the PR description are not covered. GitHub's docs say they close the issue, while this repository's record (CLAUDE.md, PRs 477 to 480, 487, 488) shows body-only keywords did not. Blocking on them means reading the PR body and refusing the merge; that is a decision for the user and needs a live check.
- The title check over-matches (for example "Fix CVE-2024-1"); the cost is only the PR title.

From round 3:
- ADR 0021 D2 says the squash title is the PR title and the body always ends with the closes line. The code now follows spec 02 instead (title replaced on a closing shape; body `closes #N` only for a same-repo issue, otherwise `Merged by pacman.`). The ADR is a protected path, so it is not edited here. Proposed note for you to add to ADR 0021 or a short ADR 0021a: "D2 message clause, revised 2026-10-22 (#1403 segment 2b, PR #1509): the squash title is `<PR title> (#n)`, or `Merge pull request #n` when the PR title carries a GitHub closing keyword with a reference. The body is the closes line only when the task came from an issue of the same repository, otherwise `Merged by pacman.`; it is always sent, so GitHub never falls back to the PR body. Spec 02 holds the full rule."
- Someone without write access can open and then close a PR on the build's branch, which raises the rejection floor and blocks adoption. The card then fails and waits for a person, which is the cheaper mistake; GitHub's branch PR list does not say who closed a PR.
- A failed PR read gives a generic message without the rate-limit reset time, because `githubPull` reports every read failure as null.
- With `PACMAN_TOKEN` unset, the merge route cannot tell a person from an agent on a machine that reaches the server port. This auth scope predates the PR, but the route now writes to the default branch.

Not done: pr-gate suggestion 1 from #1489, adoption of a PR opened after the close was reported. It needs new state and a new rule.

Segment 3 is still open: checks by head SHA, BEHIND and DIRTY handling, and exact step finish times.

This PR changes the merge path and is about 2,200 lines outside `docs/verify/`, so it waits for a user merge.

## Acceptance

- [x] Pressing merge on a GitHub-form task with a PR merges through REST with `sha` and squash; the card is done only when GitHub says merged (`pr-merge-api.test.ts`, red/green)
- [x] A refusal, including a rate limit, answers 409 with GitHub's message and writes nothing; an unclear answer writes one row and the reconcile finishes (`pr-merge-api.test.ts`)
- [x] Other forms keep the merge step; queued merge steps do not finish a GitHub build that has a PR
- [x] Adoption requires the PR author's write association; the pr-gate pins from #1489 (`pr-reconcile.test.ts`)
- [x] 51 of 51 and 7 of 7 mutations caught (`seg2b-mutations.txt`)
- [x] lint / typecheck / spec:parse / vitest --changed / e2e:affected (full suite) pass (`gates-seg2b.txt`), again after merging main `b57b4a0`
- [x] A PR title with a closing shape never reaches the squash title, and the body is always pacman's own (`pr-merge-api.test.ts` D41, D42, D2; 71 of 71 mutations, `seg2b-mutations-2.txt`)
- [x] Round 3: the rejection floor counts every own PR, and a failed PR read refuses without a PUT (`pr-reconcile.test.ts` 2b-P7g/h, `pr-merge-api.test.ts` 2b-D44; 8 of 8 mutations, `seg2b-r3-mutations.txt`; gates `gates-seg2b-r3.txt`)
- [x] Merge with #1505 keeps #1487's refusal first and team-scoped GitHub routing (`pr-merge-api.test.ts` 2b-M1 to 2b-M3, `seg2b-merge-main.txt`)

## Issues

Part of #1403 (segment 2b). Segment 3 carries the closing line for #1403, so this squash body has none.

Squash with this message:

```
server(1403): pressing merge on a GitHub task merges its PR through the API (#1509)

For a GitHub-form build with a recorded PR, requestMerge merges the PR
with PUT pulls/n/merge, sha set to the build's last pushed checkpoint,
squash, the PR title with its number (pacman's own title when the PR
title has a closing shape), and a body of its own that carries closes
#N only for an issue of the same repository. It checks the phase, the current build, the
PR's identity, author, base and head first and writes nothing before
the answer. Merged: a merged row and done. Refused, rate limits
included: 409 with GitHub's message. No clear answer: one row, and the
reconcile finishes. Merges in flight block the sweep; queued merge
steps no longer finish such a build; other forms keep the merge step.
Adoption requires the author's write association, and a PR closed
unmerged on the branch blocks adopting older ones. Rate-limit headers
share one parser. A merge step already in flight is refused first, and
only a GitHub project of the todo's own team takes the API path.

Part of #1403.
```

mergedPulls.title: server(1491): background tasks pass a trigger gate before each run
mergedPulls.body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"xiechimon"} -->
_Requested by **ian** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WRVEp3Ljey1pvjthhYAqdU?thread=cmsg_01WRVEp3Ljey1pvjthhYAqdUVespymXUu1k3DVC8SxuYdc)_

## What

Background runs (issue intake now, the gardener #1407 and auto-merge #1405 later) check one gate before starting. Before this PR the only check was the in-flight cap of 3.

- `apps/server/src/services/autonomy-gates.ts`: `evaluateAutonomyGates(input)` is a pure function. It returns `{ ok: true }` or `{ ok: false, reason }`. Order, first failure wins: `disabled` → `dormant` (main head unchanged since the last run of this kind; unreadable head = not dormant) → `in-flight-cap` → `member-active` (a member wrote within `quietMinutes`) → `cooldown` (same kind started within `cooldownMinutes`) → `budget` / `budget-unreadable` (today's UTC spend of chief and schedule builds in the project, unreadable = blocked). The reason list is `AUTONOMY_GATE_REASONS` in `packages/shared/src/records/autonomy.ts`.
- Thresholds live in `project.autonomy` (JSON, null = `DEFAULT_AUTONOMY_SETTINGS`: on, 10 min quiet, 15 min cooldown, 10 USD/day). Setting a number to 0 turns that gate off.
- `autonomy_state` keeps, per (project, kind), the last start, the dormancy baseline SHA and the last verdict. `GET` / `PATCH /api/projects/{id}/autonomy` read and write it.
- `member_activity` records the time of the last successful `/api/` write. An app middleware writes it and skips `/api/machine`, `/api/mcp`, `/api/webhook` and `/api/oauth/callback`, so agent, daemon and webhook traffic does not count.
- Issue intake (`issue-intake.ts`) evaluates the gate per project before reading the list. A blocked project logs `issue intake project gated` with the reason (the in-flight cap is not logged every round) and is re-evaluated next round. Candidates are not dropped. The first import of a round records the start for the cooldown.
- The webhook import and orchestration retries only check the switch and the daily budget (`evaluateRequestedRun`). A GitHub label is an explicit request, so these paths do not yield to members or wait for the cooldown.
- The project settings page shows a "后台自动任务" card for GitHub projects. It has the switch, three numbers, today's spend and the last verdict per kind.

![autonomy card](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/pacman/36fd344e400d2d0e94bbda849ae27dcc68d1aef1/docs/verify/1491/settings-autonomy-card.png)

## Verified

Gate bypassed (the intake gate block disabled by a local edit, i.e. the old behavior), new integration group 26:

```
     × 项目关了后台自动任务 → 不读列表、不领；打开后下一轮领 130ms
     × 人刚在用（建项目是人的写操作）→ 让路；静默窗口过了再领 60ms
     × 冷却：上一轮领过，冷却内的新候选等着；冷却过了再领 80ms
     × 当天预算满 → 不领；只算 chief / 定时开的 build 113ms
     × 日预算按 UTC 日切：昨天的花费不算今天；跨过零点额度重开 53ms
     × 花费读不到 → 不领（不放行） 59ms
     × 满员照旧不读列表，也不逐轮记 gated 行；原因可查 52ms
      Tests  7 failed | 2 passed | 165 skipped (174)
```

Before the module existed, `test/autonomy-gates.test.ts` failed to load (`Test Files 1 failed, Tests no tests`).

This branch:

```
$ pnpm --filter @pacman/server exec vitest run
 Test Files  126 passed (126)
      Tests  1999 passed | 1 skipped (2000)

$ pnpm exec playwright test e2e/project-settings-autonomy.spec.ts e2e/project-settings-identity.spec.ts e2e/project-settings-local-path.spec.ts e2e/project-settings-delete.spec.ts e2e/project-settings-dead-buttons.spec.ts
  16 passed (12.5s)

$ pnpm lint        # biome ci: 0 errors
$ pnpm -r typecheck # all Done
$ pnpm spec:parse  # PASS
$ pnpm --filter @pacman/server db:generate  # No schema changes, nothing to migrate
```

The full e2e suite runs in CI.

## Upstream

No equivalent in pi, claude-agent-sdk or this repo. The design follows PilotDeck `src/always-on/runtime/DiscoveryGates.ts` (OpenBMB/PilotDeck main, read 2026-10-22). It is a pure function with a fixed order and a reason enum. Its file-watcher dormancy is replaced here with "main head unchanged since the last run", because pacman has no file watcher.

## Risk

Two-way door. Migration 0045 adds two tables and one nullable column, and the PATCH body is strict.

- Default thresholds are on for existing projects. Issue intake is still opt-in through `PACMAN_ISSUE_INTAKE`. Where it is on, intake now waits 10 minutes after any member write and 15 minutes between rounds that imported something, and it stops at 10 USD/day. Any member write anywhere on the instance counts, not just writes on that project. This repo is single-user self-hosted, so instance-wide is the conservative reading.
- The budget counts builds with `triggerSource` chief or schedule. That includes builds a person started by chatting with chief, which over-counts. Chief thread turns (the orchestration itself) are not counted. `token_usage` rows for chief threads have no project and no date. Attributing them needs a schema change, so it stays out of this PR.
- Cost is attributed to the UTC day the build was created, not the day the tokens were spent.
- A future timestamp within one window (clock moved back) still blocks. Beyond one window it is ignored, so a clock jump cannot lock the gate for a day.
- `NON_MEMBER_API_PREFIXES` repeats the machine-facing paths from `lib/token-auth.ts`. The comment says to keep them in sync. `lib/token-auth.ts` itself is unchanged.
- `/code-review` (medium) found 10 issues. Fixed: webhook and retry paths ignored the gate, the clock-jump lock, spend read when the budget is off, the settings card flashing old values, rows shown for kinds that never ran, and routes inserted under the delete comment. Not fixed, with reasons above: default-on thresholds (the ticket asks for conservative defaults), chief-thread cost, and the duplicated path list. Kept on purpose: the dormancy input and the gardener / auto-merge kinds have no caller yet. The ticket puts them in the shared function for #1407 and #1405.

## Acceptance

- [x] `evaluateAutonomyGates` unit tests written before the implementation: one blocking case and one just-passing boundary per reason (`apps/server/test/autonomy-gates.test.ts`, 26 tests)
- [x] Issue intake calls the function; integration tests cover "budget full, not taken" and "member just acted, not taken" (`issue-intake.test.ts` group 26, plus webhook `#1491 W 触发闸`)
- [x] Failure modes: unreadable spend blocks; UTC day cut tested across midnight; only member writes count (`autonomy-api.test.ts`); unreadable dormancy head is not dormant; blocked candidates are re-evaluated next round
- [x] Blocked reason logged and visible on the settings page (screenshot above, `project-settings-autonomy.spec.ts`)
- [x] Thresholds in project settings, conservative defaults, each gate can be turned off
- [x] lint / typecheck / spec:parse / vitest pass

The gardener hookup (#1407) is tracked on that ticket.

## Issues

Closes #1491

mergedPulls.title: server(1404): merge gate S4b, the gate's GitHub shell, evidence presence and status plan
mergedPulls.body:
## What

Segment S4b of #1404, part of bootstrap phase P3 (the merge-readiness gate, `docs/spec/28` §4 P3). It builds the gate's GitHub shell on top of the transport from #1503 (S4a). The plan is in [s4-plan.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/pacman/9e145418ba3d828f5f0c6c75fba4a362c3e0dedc/docs/verify/1404/s4-plan.md) and on #1404 ([comment](https://github.com/xiechimon/pacman/issues/1404#issuecomment-6339562372)).

New gate source, all under `apps/server/src/services/merge-gate/`:
- `github-port.ts`: the port the gate reads GitHub through. Gate source never imports `lib/github.ts`.
- `github-facts.ts`: `readGateGithubFacts` builds the GitHub half of `GateInputs`. It reads the PR, the branch and its rules, the required-check list, every compare page and every check-run and status page by the head SHA, and computes `baseBehindBy`. `readCompareAt` is exported for S5a. An unreadable input never passes.
- `gate-status.ts`: plans the `pacman/merge-gate` commit status. It never plans a write under `mergePolicy=human`, and it does not write when its own status could not be read.
- `readiness.ts`: `GateInputs.evidence` and one rule. An evidence link counts only when its file exists at the linked commit. Links past the 5-probe cap read as unknown, not absent.
- `evidence-link.ts`: the path-safety item from [comment 6314008085](https://github.com/xiechimon/pacman/issues/1404#issuecomment-6314008085). Encoded `..` and `/` are refused.

Outside the gate source:
- `apps/server/src/services/merge-gate-github.ts` binds S4a's transport into the port.
- `lib/github.ts`: one comment now points to the header's list of three write points (pr-gate suggestion on #1503).
- `docs/spec/28` §8: only the P3 row changes.

Nothing calls `readGateGithubFacts` or the status planner yet; S6a and S7 wire them.

## Verified

Failure modes first ([s4b-failure-modes.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/pacman/9e145418ba3d828f5f0c6c75fba4a362c3e0dedc/docs/verify/1404/s4b-failure-modes.txt), B-1 to B-45). The fixtures are the read-only GitHub captures from S4a.

Tests first ([s4b-red-green.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/pacman/9e145418ba3d828f5f0c6c75fba4a362c3e0dedc/docs/verify/1404/s4b-red-green.txt)), six merge-gate test files:

```
new modules stubbed, old readiness and evidence-link   Tests  44 failed | 183 passed (227)
real code                                              Tests  227 passed (227)
code-review pins on unfixed code                       3 of 20 fail  ->  all pass
```

The 183 passes in the red leg are the earlier gate tests plus pins the old code already met; the file lists them.

Mutations ([s4b-mutations.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/pacman/9e145418ba3d828f5f0c6c75fba4a362c3e0dedc/docs/verify/1404/s4b-mutations.txt)): 103 of 103 caught on the final code. The first run caught 95 of 102; new tests killed the four survivors, and one mutant was rewritten after the flag it changed was removed. Two were dropped as equivalent, with the reasons in the file. The list and runner are kept as `.txt`.

Gates on `62f691c`, after merging main `c99de10` ([gates-s4b.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/pacman/9e145418ba3d828f5f0c6c75fba4a362c3e0dedc/docs/verify/1404/gates-s4b.txt)):
- lint, typecheck, spec:parse: exit 0;
- `vitest run --changed origin/main`: the first run had one 5,000 ms timeout in `m4b-memory.test.ts`, which this branch does not touch; the rerun passed (2060 passed, 1 skipped), and that file passed 9 of 9 on three runs alone. Both runs are in the file;
- `e2e:affected`: 8 passed.

Reviews ([s4b-reviews.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/pacman/9e145418ba3d828f5f0c6c75fba4a362c3e0dedc/docs/verify/1404/s4b-reviews.txt)):
- /simplify, one inline pass, no change.
- /code-review at medium found 9 possible problems. Four were fixed with a failing test first: an incomplete status read makes the gate's own status unreadable; links past the probe cap are unknown; protection with `enforcement_level` off adds no required checks; `readCompare` reports only its own failure. The rest are in Risk.
- /security-review: the skill read another checkout, so the diff was reviewed by hand under its rules. No new credential, host or write path; gate source makes no network call of its own. No finding at confidence 8 or above.

**Round 2, from the pr-gate run at `63f23fc`** (go, five suggestions; dispositions in the dated section of [s4b-reviews.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/pacman/9e145418ba3d828f5f0c6c75fba4a362c3e0dedc/docs/verify/1404/s4b-reviews.txt)):
- The check-run and combined-status cache keys carried the PR number, so after a push the old head's ETag went out with the new head's request. They now carry the head SHA. Test F19 failed 1 of 21 on `63f23fc` and passes after; mutations N106 and N107 put the old keys back and are caught.
- An end-to-end case feeds a 300-file compare page with `changed_files` 301 through `readGateGithubFacts` into `mergeReadiness` and gets the human `compare-truncated` blocker. It passed at once, so it is a pin; N108 kills it.
- Main `0a5bc64` is merged, with no conflict. The six merge-gate test files pass 229 of 229; mutations total 106 of 106.
- Gates on `800d43d` ([gates-s4b.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/pacman/9e145418ba3d828f5f0c6c75fba4a362c3e0dedc/docs/verify/1404/gates-s4b.txt)), all exit 0: lint, typecheck, spec:parse, `vitest run --changed origin/main` (2062 passed, 1 skipped), `e2e:affected` (8 passed).

The #1503 pr-gate items are taken here. Stray lines in S4a's red-green record are explained in [s4a-red-green-correction.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/pacman/9e145418ba3d828f5f0c6c75fba4a362c3e0dedc/docs/verify/1404/s4a-red-green-correction.txt); the old file is unchanged.

## Upstream

No dependency. GitHub REST reads from S4a (#1503) and the commit status write; their parameters and pagination are quoted in the plan.

## Risk

Two-way door: new gate source with no caller.

Kept from /code-review:
- Required checks are matched by name, not by the app a branch rule pins them to, so another app or a commit status with the same name could stand in. This was the plan's Q3 decision; GitHub's `mergeable_state` still reports blocked while the pinned app has not reported.
- Over 1,000 commits or 1,000 check runs, a PR waits instead of going to a person (plan §4.3).
- The read cache grows without bound. The caller owns its lifetime, so eviction belongs with the S6a/S7 wiring.
- If GitHub normalizes stored status descriptions, the "unchanged" check would never match and the gate would rewrite the same status. Checking needs a live write, which S7 should capture on the drill repo.

From the #1503 and #1525 pr-gate runs: the gate's transport in `lib/github.ts` and its port binding in `services/merge-gate-github.ts` sit outside the D4 ④ locations, so a later change there could alter what the gate reads. It is deferred to P4 (#1405); no autonomous merge exists before then.

The live GitHub leg (the shell reading a real PR and writing a real status) is 待宿主.

This PR changes `merge-gate/**` (D4 ④), so it waits for a user merge.

## Acceptance

- [x] The gate reads GitHub only through its port; unreadable inputs never pass (`merge-gate-github-facts.test.ts`, red/green)
- [x] The status planner never writes under `human` or blind (`merge-gate-status.test.ts`)
- [x] Evidence links count only when the file exists at the linked commit; path safety (`merge-gate-evidence-link.test.ts`, `merge-gate-readiness.test.ts`)
- [x] 106 of 106 mutations caught, including the per-head cache keys (`s4b-mutations.txt`)
- [x] lint / typecheck / spec:parse / vitest --changed / e2e:affected pass (`gates-s4b.txt`)

## Issues

Part of #1404 (S4b). The last P3 segment carries the closing line for #1404, so this squash body has none.

Squash with this message:

```
server(1404): merge gate S4b, the gate's GitHub shell, evidence presence and status plan (#1525)

merge-gate gains a GitHub port, bound to lib/github.ts's transport from
outside the gate source, and readGateGithubFacts, which reads the PR,
branch rules, required checks, every compare, check-run and status page
by the head SHA, and computes how far the base is ahead; an unreadable
input never passes. GateInputs carries evidence presence: a link counts
only when its file exists at the linked commit. gate-status plans the
pacman/merge-gate status and never writes under human or blind. Encoded
```

mergedPulls.body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"xiechimon"} -->
_Requested by **ian** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WRVEp3Ljey1pvjthhYAqdU?thread=cmsg_01WRVEp3Ljey1pvjthhYAqdU4DjfTTK6LJXp6kyQYzewKn)_

## What

Implements #1492, following the scope written down in [the ticket comment](https://github.com/xiechimon/pacman/issues/1492#issuecomment-6340368378).

- **Plan structure check.** `checkPlanContract` in `packages/shared/src/records/plan.ts` requires a non-empty `Verification` section in plan.md. Every item needs a checkable anchor: inline code, a fenced block, a repo path or file name, a URL, an API path, or a command word. Items with TODO / TBD / 待定 / 待补 are rejected. The check uses rules only, with no LLM judge. The other three sections stay free text.
- **Gate.** `stepArtifactGate` / `completeStep` in `apps/server/src/services/builds.ts` check only the plan version uploaded by this plan step, so old plan rows are not re-checked. A failing plan stays in planning and gets one structure rewrite round (`buildPlanContractRewritePrompt`, which names the failing items). If the rewrite round still fails, the step fails with `方案结构不合格：...`. That is one rewrite per planning round, the same cap the existing rewrite has.
- **Verify by checklist.** `buildVerifyStepPrompt` lists the plan's Verification items with numbers and asks for an `item` index on each evidence entry (`verifyEvidenceSchema.item`, optional). `reconcileVerifyVerdict` runs when the verify step finishes. Any checklist item without evidence sets `passed` to false, and the conclusion names the item. If no evidence carries an index (an old daemon, for example), the verdict is kept and the conclusion says it was not reconciled item by item.
- **Build fallback report.** `applyStepFailure` writes a system note `构建步兜底报告` for every build-step failure (machine-reported, artifact gate, sweep). The note lists the reason, the known changed files, the PR, and the next step. An empty failure reason is replaced with `<kind> 步异常结束，未上报原因`, so the card's failure banner still renders.
- **dedupeKey.** `packages/shared/src/records/ticket-dedupe.ts` adds `ticketDedupeKey` (category plus sorted paths), a hidden issue-body marker, and `findDuplicateTicket`. #1407 has no ticket-opening code yet, so nothing in production calls these. They exist for #1407 to call.
- **Prompt text.** The first-round plan instruction and the rewrite instruction now carry `PLAN_VERIFICATION_RULE`. The previous wording of both is still classified as synthetic, so stored rows in old conversations do not show up as user bubbles.

Test plan fixtures across `apps/server/test` and `integration/test` now carry a valid Verification section, through `withVerification` in `apps/server/test/helpers.ts`.

## Verified

The new gate tests run against `origin/main` (old code, in a scratch worktree) and fail:

```
     × 失败方式 10、12：首轮空话方案 → 留 planning，入队点名问题的结构补写轮 66ms
     × 失败方式 11：结构补写轮仍不合格 → 失败收尾，原因点名，plan 步封顶两轮 269ms
     × 失败方式 13：结构补写轮没重新上传 → 按旧版判，仍不合格即失败 277ms
     × 结构补写轮补齐 Verification → 进 confirm 264ms
     × 失败方式 15：build 步机器报失败 → 落兜底报告，含失败原因 60ms
     × 产物闸失败（构建零改动）同样落兜底报告 58ms
     × 失败方式 16：失败原因为空串 → errorMessage 补成说明文字 48ms
AssertionError: expected 'confirm' to be 'planning' // Object.is equality
AssertionError: expected '' to be 'build 步异常结束，未上报原因' // Object.is equality
      Tests  7 failed | 15 passed (22)
```

The same runs on this branch:

```
packages/shared   Tests  534 passed (534)
apps/server       Tests  1949 passed | 1 skipped (1950)   Test Files  124 passed (124)
apps/daemon       Tests  942 passed (942)
apps/web          Tests  534 passed (534)
integration (real server + daemon + pi session + stub LLM, 7 files)   Tests  15 passed (15)
pnpm lint         Checked 817 files. No fixes applied.
pnpm typecheck    all 5 packages Done
pnpm spec:parse   PASS: every spec in apps/web/e2e and integration/test parses.
```

Per-test listings are committed:

- [shared-unit.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/pacman/a2818b87854efa1a8d8e9b13e972ccb46fed5d73/docs/verify/1492/shared-unit.txt): structure check (missing section, vague items, valid), rewrite prompt, dedupe key, verify reconcile.
- [server-gate.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/pacman/a2818b87854efa1a8d8e9b13e972ccb46fed5d73/docs/verify/1492/server-gate.txt): gate and fallback report, plus plan, confirm, build and verify over HTTP, with the checklist in the verify prompt and a missing item forcing `passed=false`.
- [integration-real-stack.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/pacman/a2818b87854efa1a8d8e9b13e972ccb46fed5d73/docs/verify/1492/integration-real-stack.txt): real-process runs where a plan with Verification reaches confirm, and build, review, merge, crash recovery and upload recovery do not regress.

`e2e:affected` was not run here, because Playwright's chromium build is missing in this container. CI runs the full e2e suite.

## Upstream

PilotDeck `PlanContract.ts` / `ReportContract.ts` are the reference. They are not a dependency, so this ports the idea. Nothing in pi or claude-agent-sdk checks plan structure. The repo already had `PLAN_SECTIONS` and the #113/#703 rewrite gate, and this extends them without adding a new mechanism.

## Risk

This is a two-way door. It is code only, with no migration.

The main risk is a check that is too strict. A false rejection costs one rewrite round, and a second rejection fails the build. Self-review (`/code-review`) found several over-strict cases, and they are fixed and covered by tests: lowercase `todo` (a domain noun here), TODO inside backticks, `**Verification**:`, `## 4. Verification`, full-width colons, intro sentences, nested sub-bullets, `#1492` lines, and CRLF line endings.

Other things this touches:

- Every plan step's completion. Old plan rows and replans that do not re-upload are not checked. The full server suite and 7 real-stack integration files are green.
- Verify verdict messages. `item` is optional, and a string number is coerced. An old daemon that drops `item` does not get forced to fail.
- A new system note on every build failure. The web suite is green, and plain system rows already render as notes.

`ticketDedupe*` has no production caller until #1407. This is intended, per the ticket scope comment.

The banned-vocabulary hook was passed with `PACMAN_ALLOW_BANNED_VOCAB=1`, because the word TODO is the subject of the check.

## Acceptance

- [x] Structure check unit tests written before the implementation, covering missing section, vague items and valid plans: `packages/shared/test/plan-contract.test.ts`, see shared-unit.txt
- [x] Real stack: a plan with Verification reaches the confirm card, and the verify step judges by the checklist. integration-real-stack.txt covers plan to confirm on real processes. The verify-by-checklist chain over HTTP is in server-gate.txt (`#1492 verify 步按清单出判定`). Evidence is in `docs/verify/1492/`.
- [x] dedupeKey tests: `packages/shared/test/ticket-dedupe.test.ts`
- [x] lint / typecheck / spec:parse / vitest pass (see Verified). e2e runs in CI.

## Issues

Closes #1492. The closing keyword is in the first commit's message.

mergedPulls.title: server(1404): merge gate S4a, raw GitHub transport for the gate's reads and the status write
mergedPulls.body:
## What

Segment S4a of #1404, part of bootstrap phase P3 (the merge-readiness gate, `docs/spec/28` §4 P3). It adds the raw GitHub transport that the gate's shell (S4b) will call. The plan is on #1404 ([comment](https://github.com/xiechimon/pacman/issues/1404#issuecomment-6339562372)), and the full text is in [s4-plan.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/pacman/c826dc151a9f99479e52da3c2217ed780f0fb420/docs/verify/1404/s4-plan.md).

New functions in `apps/server/src/lib/github.ts`.

Reads:
- `githubPullRaw`;
- `githubBranchRaw`, whose response also carries the branch protection summary;
- `githubBranchRulesRaw`;
- `githubCompareRaw`;
- `githubCheckRunsRaw`;
- `githubCombinedStatusRaw`;
- `githubContentsRaw`.

Write: `githubCreateCommitStatus` (`POST statuses/{sha}`). It is added to the file header's list of write endpoints.

How they behave:
- Each function sends exactly one request and returns the response without interpreting it. The caller passes every parameter that changes what GitHub returns, such as page, per_page, filter and ref; nothing is defaulted inside.
- The token goes only in the Authorization header. Requests reach api.github.com only, with validated and encoded path segments.
- A 304 counts as not-modified only when an ETag was sent.
- Failures come back as one of `invalid`, `timeout`, `network`, `rate-limited` (with reset and retry-after), `status` or `not-json`, with GitHub's message cleaned. Nothing throws.
- The seven reads share one `gateGet` helper, and SHA arguments go through the file's existing `isFullSha`.

Nothing calls these functions yet. S4b, the shell inside `merge-gate/**`, wires the reads after #1479. S7 schedules the status write.

## Verified

Failure modes come first ([s4a-failure-modes.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/pacman/c826dc151a9f99479e52da3c2217ed780f0fb420/docs/verify/1404/s4a-failure-modes.txt), FM-1 to FM-20). Each read endpoint was captured read-only from this repository with `gh api` ([s4a-github-shapes.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/pacman/c826dc151a9f99479e52da3c2217ed780f0fb420/docs/verify/1404/s4a-github-shapes.txt)), and those captures are the test fixtures. The captures show four things S4b depends on:
- the rules endpoint answers 200 with `[]` for a branch that does not exist;
- page 2 of a compare has no `files` key;
- a 304 echoes the strong form of a weak ETag;
- `pr-evidence` appears twice under `filter=latest`, once in each of two check suites.

The status POST is tested against a fake only; nothing was written live.

Tests first ([s4a-red-green.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/pacman/c826dc151a9f99479e52da3c2217ed780f0fb420/docs/verify/1404/s4a-red-green.txt)), in `apps/server/test/github-gate-transport.test.ts`:

```
eight functions stubbed out     Tests  72 failed | 8 passed (80)
real code                       Tests  80 passed (80)
review pins on unfixed code     Tests  2 failed | 78 passed (80)  ->  80 passed
```

The 8 tests that pass against the stubs check only that a failure carries no token, which any stub satisfies. The existing GitHub suites still pass, 450 of 450.

Mutations ([s4a-mutations.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/pacman/c826dc151a9f99479e52da3c2217ed780f0fb420/docs/verify/1404/s4a-mutations.txt)): 113 of 113 caught on the final code. The first run had one survivor (no test sent an invalid page to the rules read); the test was extended to cover it. The mutation list and runners are kept as `.txt` files, because an executable file under `docs/verify/` would itself trip the gate's executable-evidence blocker.

Gates at `2dd471d` ([gates-s4a.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/pacman/c826dc151a9f99479e52da3c2217ed780f0fb420/docs/verify/1404/gates-s4a.txt)), all exit 0:
- `pnpm lint` (1 existing info in `apps/web`);
- `pnpm typecheck`;
- `pnpm spec:parse`;
- `vitest run --changed origin/main` (1782 passed, 1 skipped);
- `e2e:affected` (8 passed).

Reviews ([s4a-reviews.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiechimon/pacman/c826dc151a9f99479e52da3c2217ed780f0fb420/docs/verify/1404/s4a-reviews.txt)):
- /simplify ran as one inline pass.
- /code-review at medium raised 8 findings. Two were fixed with failing tests written first:
  - a timeout above the timer limit is refused as `invalid` instead of surfacing as a network error;
  - an error body whose read timed out comes back as `timeout`, unless the headers already show a rate limit.

  Three were also fixed: per-function timeout signals in the test, `URLSearchParams` for the query string, and the 422 comment.
- /security-review: the skill collected its diff from another checkout, so the diff was reviewed by hand under its rules. It covered token placement, host and path validation, ETag characters, the exact status body, cleaned messages, and the absence of any new credential or scope. No high or medium finding.

## Upstream

No dependency. GitHub REST endpoints: pulls, branches, rules for a branch, compare, check runs for a ref, combined status, contents, and create a commit status. Their parameters, pagination, permissions and status codes are quoted with URLs in the plan's GitHub facts section.

## Risk

Two-way door: these are new functions with no caller.

Kept from /code-review:
- Branch names and paths that contain `?` or `#` are refused. This is the plan's conservative choice; it also refuses legal names such as `fix#12`.
- There is no local 140-character cap on the status description, because GitHub does not document that limit. S4b truncates.
- The older list and intake reads were not folded onto the new helper, because that would change existing behaviour.

`lib/github.ts` is ordinary product source, so a later change there could alter what the gate reads. The plan's mitigation: the gate passes every parameter, and no autonomous merge exists before P4 settles this (#1405).

## Acceptance

- [x] Seven raw reads and the status write; each one sends one request, returns the response unread, takes every parameter from the caller and keeps the token in the header (`github-gate-transport.test.ts`, red/green)
- [x] Live shapes captured and used as fixtures; no live write (`s4a-github-shapes.txt`)
- [x] 113 of 113 mutations caught (`s4a-mutations.txt`)
- [x] lint / typecheck / spec:parse / vitest --changed / e2e:affected pass (`gates-s4a.txt`)

## Issues

Part of #1404 (S4a). The last P3 segment carries the closing line for #1404, so this squash body has none.

Squash with this message:

```

lib/github.ts gains the raw reads the merge gate's shell will call
(PR, branch with its protection summary, branch rules, compare page,
check-runs page, combined-status page, contents) and the commit status
write. Each sends one request, returns the response unread, takes
every parameter from the caller, keeps the token in the Authorization
header, counts a 304 only when an ETag was sent, and reports failures
as invalid, timeout, network, rate-limited, status or not-json without
throwing. Nothing calls them yet.

Part of #1404.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
```
